name: Ukon
source:
A brave and good-natured warrior.
While rough around the edges and a little boisterous, he commands immense respect from his men.
He likes Haku and Kuon, whom he met at an inn, and takes them on a journey to the imperial capital.
His true identity is Oshtor, a man who hides his true identity and uses his form as an Ukon to secretly patrol the city.
